text:
maria-cs: Kicking off Dynamo reserved-capacity bring-up for next-week renewal QBR. Need quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a 30m smoke + 1h soak. Prefer Wed 14:00 PT. @raj-eng can you confirm pool and warm IPs? Dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/dash/clients/dynamo :calendar:
raj-eng: I can reserve pool-42 (4x A100s) and warm IPs. Need expected RPS and p95 SLOs to size priming.
maria-cs: Planning for steady 120 RPS, ~500 tokens/request avg. Target p95 < 400ms. Renewal risk if we miss p95 or cost delta > 15%.
jules-ops: Drafting a lightweight run: 1) reserve pool-42 + seed cache 2) priming run 10k tokens 3) shadow 10% for 30m 4) ramp to 100% for 60m 5) rollback window 15m. Putting checklist in /runbooks/dedicated/bringup-lite.md :memo:
sasha-sre: Proposed autoscale: min=2, target_util=0.7, max=16. Also enable aggressive batching cap to avoid tiny batches. I can apply policy; will trigger infra-bot to ack.
deploy-bot: autoscale policy applied to pool-42: {"min":2,"target_util":0.7,"max":16} :white_check_mark:
maria-cs: Load script for ops: ./tools/loadgen --target https://dynamo.redwood/api --rps 120 --workers 30 --avg-tokens 500 --duration 5400
raj-eng: Starting small now on dyno-test-3 to validate KV priming. Capturing token_cost, kv_cache_hit, batch_size, and p95. Posting logs to /tmp/dynamo-warm.log
jules-ops: Monitor these panels: token_rate, kv_cache_hit, batch_size, p95_latency, gpu_util. Abort if p95 > 500ms or GPU util > 92% for >5m. Abort command: /abort-load or run: ./tools/loadgen --stop
sasha-sre: Add fallback route to quantized variant q4_0_small when p95 crosses 800ms for >2m. Will add routing rule to the smart router.
maria-cs: Reminder: capture enablement notes during the run (who watched the dashboard, what we told customer). Post-test survey: 3 quick Qs for Dynamo SWAT: 1) Onboarding docs clear? 2) Autoscale behaving as expected? 3) Anything missing for daily ops? I'll ping them after.
tay-analytics: Noted. I'll attach per-customer cost delta CSV and a short plot of token_cost vs latency after the soak. Will also flag any anomalies in batch_size distribution.
maria-cs: Thanks team. Final check: @raj-eng please confirm IPs + RLs are whitelisted for their corp network, and @jules-ops leave 2h rollback window post-soak. :thumbsup: :party_parrot:
raj-eng: Confirmed whitelists applied to 52.12.8.0/26 and 52.12.9.0/26. Rollback window scheduled. Starting priming run in ~10m.
jules-ops: Copy. Will be on-call for the window. I'll post a short postmortem note with bullet points once complete.
maria-cs: Great — will capture notes for renewal packet. If anything looks off, escalate to @sasha-sre immediately
